integrity.method: analytical Lucas-congruence, cyclic-sign factorization, and root-of-unity convergence; tests only corroborate

scientific_limitations: Pure qubit states with every hyperedge of arity \(2^j-1\), \(j\ge3\), and cuts \(m,b\ge2^j-1\). Spectral convergence first lets both blocks tend to infinity at fixed arity, then grows arity. No arbitrary-arity or simultaneous-limit assertion.
title: Schmidt-rank growth with vanishing entropy in complete Mersenne-uniform hypergraph states
